name: PricePress – Advanced Dynamic Pricing, Bulk Discounts, Tiered Pricing, BOGO, Free Gifts & Cart Rules for WooCommerce
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
Unlock your store’s full revenue potential with PricePress — the ultimate Dynamic Pricing and Discount Rules plugin for WooCommerce. Engineered with a blazing-fast React interface, native WooCommerce HPOS optimization, and enterprise-grade promotional tools, PricePress empowers merchants to launch high-converting pricing campaigns that increase Average Order Value (AOV), accelerate inventory turnover, and turn one-time shoppers into repeat buyers.

Forget static store pricing and clunky coupon codes that shoppers forget to apply. PricePress automatically calculates and delivers personalized discounts in real-time across your product catalog, category archives, cart, and checkout — with zero checkout latency and zero coding required. Launch Amazon-style tiered volume pricing, BOGO (Buy One Get One) deals, Free Gifts with Purchase (GWP), Mix & Match product bundles, and customer-specific discounts with total control.

Get the PRO version for Unlimited Rules, Advanced LTV Targeting & Priority Support →

🚀 Why Top WooCommerce Stores Choose PricePress

Standard WooCommerce pricing is rigid. Relying solely on coupon codes introduces checkout friction, cart abandonment, and margin leakage. PricePress transforms your store into an automated revenue-generating engine:

  • Skyrocket Average Order Value (AOV): Motivate customers to add extra items to unlock quantity breaks, tiered subtotal savings, or free shipping.
  • Eliminate Cart Abandonment: Reward shoppers automatically without forcing them to hunt for coupon codes.
  • Liquidate Slow-Moving Inventory: Clear out clearance items and seasonal stock with targeted product-tag discounts, BOGO bundles, and flash sales.
  • Reward VIP & Wholesale Buyers: Deliver automated price tiers for wholesale accounts, B2B customers, and VIP subscribers based on WordPress user roles.
  • Acquire First-Time Customers: Automatically welcome first-time shoppers with an exclusive first-order discount when order history equals zero.
  • Safeguard Profit Margins: Prevent costly coupon stacking with built-in Rule Exclusivity (Individual Use Only), global caps, and per-user redemption limits.
  • Blazing-Fast Microsecond Performance: Built with context caching, optimized database queries, and 100% native WooCommerce HPOS support.

⚡ Comprehensive Discount Rule Engines

PricePress includes every promotional discount structure needed to scale an e-commerce business:

1. Tiered Volume Pricing & Quantity Breaks

Incentivize bulk purchases by lowering the unit cost as the customer buys more.
* Discount Calculation Modes: Percentage Discount (e.g. Buy 3–5 get 10% off; 6+ get 20% off), Fixed Amount Off Per Unit ($5 off each unit for 5+), or Flat Fixed Unit Price ($25 each when buying 3+).
* Responsive On-Page Pricing Table: Automatically renders a customizable volume pricing grid directly on single product pages. Customers see instant price tiers before clicking Add to Cart.
* Dynamic Shop & Archive Loop Display: Displays strikethrough original prices and <ins>From $min_price</ins> tags on shop, category, and archive cards so shoppers spot bulk savings immediately while browsing.

2. Advanced BOGO (Buy One Get One & Buy X Get Y)

Drive viral volume and cross-sell related merchandise with automated BOGO rules.
* Same-Product BOGO: “Buy 2 T-Shirts, Get 1 Free” or “Buy 1 Pair of Shoes, Get the 2nd Pair at 50% Off”.
* Cross-Product BOGO: “Buy a Camera Body, Get a 50mm Lens at 40% Off”.
* Category Choice BOGO: “Buy any Winter Jacket, choose any Beanie or Gloves from Accessories for Free”.
* Flexible Reward Pricing: Configure companion items as 100% Free, percentage discounted, or fixed amount off.

3. Free Gift with Purchase (GWP)

Delight shoppers, increase purchase satisfaction, and boost checkout completion rates with free gift rewards.
* Automatic Auto-Add Gift: Injects promotional free gift items directly into the shopper’s cart as soon as qualifying criteria (e.g. $75 spend or specific product purchase) are met.
* Free Gift Variation Switcher: Gifts are added to the cart automatically once qualified. For variable gift products, shoppers can switch the gift variation (size, colour) directly in the cart.
* Cart Removal Safeguard: If items are removed and cart subtotal drops below the threshold, the free gift is automatically removed to protect margins.

4. Mix & Match Custom Bundles (“Pick Any X for $Y”)

Empower shoppers to create custom product bundles across collections and categories.
* Fixed Bundle Price: “Pick any 3 items from our Gourmet Sauce collection for a flat $30.”
* Bundle Percentage Savings: “Choose any 4 accessories and save 25% across all selected items.”
* Cross-Category Bundles: Combine qualifying items across separate categories (e.g., 1 Shirt + 1 Pants + 1 Belt for $85).

5. Spend More, Save More (Tiered Subtotal Discounts)

Reward high-value orders with automatic tiered savings calculated on cart subtotal:
* Spend $75, save $10.
* Spend $150, save $25.
* Spend $250, save $50.

6. Cart Total Item Quantity Breaks

Reward shoppers based on total item quantity in their cart (e.g., “Add any 5 items storewide and receive 15% off your entire order”). Ideal for bookstores, apparel, and grocery stores.

7. Smart Free Shipping Reward & Animated Progress Bar

Eliminate the #1 cause of cart abandonment — unexpected shipping costs — by unlocking free shipping as an automatic bonus reward.
* Visual Cart Progress Bar: Displays a real-time, animated progress bar on the cart page (e.g., “Add $14.50 more to unlock Free Shipping!”).
* Automatic Shipping Method Unlock: Dynamically activates the Free Shipping rate in WooCommerce checkout once the threshold is reached.

8. Product Catalog On-Sale Badges & Ribbons

Catch shoppers’ attention across your catalog with vibrant, customizable on-sale badges.
* Dynamic Badge Templates: Display customizable badge text, such as Save {discount}, 20% OFF, or HOT DEAL.
* Custom Palette & Styling: Pick custom badge ribbon colors, typography weights, and corner radius to match your theme.
* Live Admin Preview: Preview your product card badge design live in settings before publishing.

🎯 Precision Targeting & Conditional Logic

Target promotions with surgical precision using PricePress’s comprehensive Condition Builder:

Customer Eligibility Conditions

  • All Shoppers: Public promotions available to every guest visitor and registered customer.
  • User Role Pricing: Deliver targeted wholesale or B2B pricing to specific WordPress user roles (Wholesale, VIP, Subscriber).
  • Customer Lifetime Spend (LTV): Grant exclusive discounts to high-value customers whose historic completed order total exceeds your threshold (e.g. Spend > $500).
  • First-Time Buyer Incentive: Automatically detect new customers with zero previous completed orders and reward them on their inaugural purchase.
  • Specific Customer Accounts: Restrict private promotions to specific customer email addresses or user IDs.

Product & Catalog Targeting

  • Storewide / All Products: Apply pricing rules across your entire catalog.
  • Specific Products & Variations: Target individual products or specific variations with live AJAX product search.
  • Product Categories: Apply discounts to entire product categories or subcategories (e.g., “20% off all Footwear”).
  • Product Tags: Target items tagged with specific keywords (e.g., clearance, summer-sale, flash-deal).

Cart Requirements

  • Cart Subtotal Limits: Set minimum or maximum cart subtotal requirements before discounts apply.
  • Cart Item Count: Require a minimum total count of items in the cart.
  • Required Coupon Code: Gate dynamic pricing rules behind a specific WooCommerce coupon code for influencer partnerships and private email campaigns.

Intelligent Campaign Scheduling

  • Continuous / Ongoing: Run promotions indefinitely with no expiration date by default.
  • Date Range Calendars: Schedule start and expiration dates down to the exact minute.
  • Happy Hour Windows: Run recurring time-of-day flash sales (e.g., 2:00 PM – 5:00 PM on weekdays).
  • Day-of-Week Scheduling: Restrict promotions to specific days of the week (e.g., “Weekend Only Specials”).

🛡️ Margin Protection & Anti-Stacking Controls

Never lose money on overlapping promotions with built-in enterprise retail safeguards:

  • Individual Use Only (Anti-Stacking): Prevent multi-rule discount compounding. When a high-priority exclusive rule applies to a product, PricePress locks that product so subsequent rules cannot compound on top of it.
  • Usage Limit Per Campaign (Global Cap): Cap the total number of times a campaign can be redeemed across your entire store (e.g., 50% off for the first 100 orders only).
  • Usage Limit Per User (Account Cap): Limit how many times an individual customer account can redeem a promotion (e.g., 1 redemption per customer).

📦 Dedicated Export & Import Hub (Backup & Migrate)

  • Granular Selective Export: Choose whether to include plugin settings, discount rules, or both, with individual checkboxes to export only specific campaigns.
  • Interactive File Inspector for Import: Upload any PricePress backup JSON file to inspect rule names, types, priorities, and statuses before restoring.
  • Seamless Migration: Transfer promotional campaigns from staging environments directly to production in seconds.

🎛️ General Configuration & Calculation Controls

  • Discount Application Mode: Choose between applying only the First Matched Rule or Stacking All Matched Rules.
  • Calculation Base: Compute percentage discounts against Regular Price or current Sale Price.
  • Tax Handling: Calculate discount thresholds Before Tax or After Tax to comply with local tax regulations.
  • Coupon Suppression: Choose whether dynamic pricing rules can stack with standard coupons or suppress coupons entirely.
  • Flexible Table Placement: Hook volume pricing tables before/after add-to-cart form, button, or product meta.
  • Custom Cart Savings Message: Highlight customer savings on the cart page (e.g., “🎉 You saved {amount} on this order!”).

💡 Real-World E-Commerce Promotion Recipes

  • Fashion & Apparel: “Buy 2 T-Shirts, Get 1 at 50% Off” + Free Shipping on orders over $50.
  • Wholesale & B2B: Tiered volume discounts on bulk hardware (1–4 units @ $20 | 5–9 units @ $16 | 10+ units @ $12) for Wholesale accounts.
  • Health & Beauty: Complimentary travel sample automatically added to cart on all orders over $70.
  • Specialty Foods: “Mix & Match any 4 gourmet spices or sauces for a flat bundle price of $35.”
  • Flash Sales: 25% off all clearance items between 12:00 AM and 11:59 PM, capped at the first 250 orders.
  • VIP Retention: Exclusive 15% off storewide for VIP customers whose historic spend exceeds $300.

⚡ Performance & WooCommerce Compatibility

  • 100% WooCommerce HPOS Certified: Fully compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (custom order tables) and traditional post-storage.
  • PHP 8.2 & 8.3 Ready: Tested and optimized for modern PHP environments from PHP 7.4 through 8.3+.
  • Theme & Page Builder Friendly: Works out-of-the-box with Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP, Flatsome, Storefront, Divi, Elementor, Bricks, Kadence, and block themes.
  • Zero Frontend Bloat: Lightweight CSS and clean vanilla JavaScript ensure optimal Google PageSpeed Insights scores and Core Web Vitals.

💎 Free vs. Pro Feature Comparison

🆓 Included in PricePress Free:

  • Tiered Volume Pricing & Quantity Breaks: Launch tiered pricing tables on product pages with live tier calculation.
  • BOGO (Buy One Get One / Buy X Get Y): Run same-product and cross-product BOGO promotions.
  • Free Gift with Purchase (GWP): Automatic free gifts with cart variation switcher.
  • Mix & Match Product Bundles: “Pick Any X for $Y” bundle deals.
  • Storewide Percentage & Fixed Discounts: Seasonal sales with custom header banners.
  • Spend More, Save More: Cart subtotal threshold discounts.
  • Free Shipping Incentive: Real-time animated spending progress bar on the cart page.
  • Product Catalog On-Sale Badges: Custom ribbons, colors, and live visual preview.
  • Rule Exclusivity & Anti-Stacking: Lock products to protect store profit margins.
  • Usage Redemption Caps: Global storewide limits and per-user redemption caps.
  • Up to 2 Active Campaigns: Run up to 2 active pricing rules simultaneously.

🚀 Advanced Capabilities Unlocked in PricePress Pro:

  • Unlimited Active Campaigns: Create and run unlimited dynamic pricing rules simultaneously.
  • Customer Lifetime Spend (LTV) Targeting: Deliver exclusive discounts based on historic order totals (e.g. Spend > $500).
  • WordPress User Role & Wholesale Pricing: Custom pricing tiers for Wholesale, B2B, VIP, and Club Member roles.
  • Advanced Multi-Category & Tag Targeting: Combine multi-category rules and product tags (clearance, flash-deal).
  • Selective JSON Export & Import: Granular backup and migration of plugin settings and specific discount rules.
  • ROI Analytics & Revenue Attribution: Real-time dashboard tracking revenue influenced and campaign ROI.
  • Priority 24/7 Technical Support: Dedicated one-on-one technical assistance from the core development team.

Upgrade to PricePress Pro for Unlimited Campaigns & Enterprise Power →

🔗 DominoPress E-Commerce Suite

  • PricePress – Advanced Dynamic Pricing & Discount Rules for WooCommerce.
  • ShopCentral – Multi-Store Manager for WooCommerce. Synchronize products, stock, and orders across multiple stores.
  • InsightPress – Advanced WooCommerce Analytics, cohort retention, and customer lifetime value reporting.
  • ClaimPress – Complete Warranty, RMA, Returns, Refunds & Exchange Management for WooCommerce.
  • DominoPost – Next-Generation WordPress Content Editor & AI Writing Assistant.
  • Autobute – Automated Image SEO Suite (Alt tags, titles, captions, and filenames).
  • Resetify – WordPress Development Reset & Database Cleaner.
sections.installation:
Minimum System Requirements

  • WordPress 6.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher (PHP 8.1+ recommended)
  • MySQL 5.7+ or MariaDB 10.3+

Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress Admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New Plugin.
  3. Type PricePress into the search field.
  4. Locate PricePress by DominoPress and click Install Now.
  5. Click Activate.
  6. Click on the new PricePress menu in your WordPress admin sidebar to build your first dynamic pricing rule.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the pricepress-dynamic-pricing-for-woocommerce.zip file.
  2. Go to WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the zip file from your computer and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin once the upload completes.

Quick Start: Launch Your First Volume Pricing Table in 2 Minutes

  1. Go to PricePress → Discount Rules → + Create New Rule.
  2. Give your campaign a title (e.g., “Volume Bulk Discount on Apparel”).
  3. Select Discount Type: “Volume & Tiered Pricing”.
  4. Configure your quantity ranges (e.g., Min 3 / Max 5: 10% off; Min 6 / Max 9: 20% off; Min 10+: 30% off).
  5. Under Promotion Target, select the products or categories you wish to include.
  6. Click Save Rule. Open your single product page to see the live dynamic pricing table!
sections.faq:
Is PricePress compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. PricePress is 100% certified for WooCommerce HPOS custom order tables as well as traditional WordPress post storage. Database lookups and order queries are heavily indexed for zero checkout latency.

Can I create tiered volume discounts with different percentage breaks?

Yes. You can add unlimited quantity brackets with custom minimums, maximums, and discount values (e.g., 3–5 items = 10% off; 6–10 items = 20% off; 11+ items = 30% off). You can choose between percentage discounts, fixed amount discounts per unit, or flat unit prices.

Does PricePress show volume discounts on product catalog and category pages?

Yes. Products with active tiered pricing rules automatically display strikethrough original prices and <ins>From $min_price</ins> tags on shop, category, and archive loops so shoppers notice bulk deals before clicking into the product page.

How does the Buy One Get One (BOGO) feature work?

PricePress supports same-product BOGO (“Buy 2 T-shirts, Get 1 Free”), cross-product BOGO (“Buy a Camera, Get an SD Card at 50% Off”), and catalog choice BOGO (“Buy 2 items from Category A, pick any item from Category B at a discount”). The reward item can be 100% free, a percentage discount, or a fixed dollar discount.

How does the Free Gift with Purchase (GWP) feature work?

Free gifts are added to the cart automatically once a qualifying subtotal or item count is reached. For variable gift products, shoppers can switch the gift variation right in the cart. If qualifying items are removed from the cart, the gift is automatically withdrawn.

What are Mix & Match bundles?

Mix & Match allows customers to choose a set number of items across selected categories or products to receive a bundle discount. For example: “Pick any 3 hot sauces for $25” or “Pick any 4 items and save 20% across all four.”

Can I prevent multiple discount rules from compounding or stacking on the same product?

Yes. PricePress includes a built-in Rule Exclusivity (Individual Use Only) engine. When you check “Individual Use Only” on a promotion, qualifying products are locked as soon as that rule applies. Lower-priority rules in your campaigns list are prevented from stacking on top of those items, protecting your margins from unintended double-discounting.

Can I restrict dynamic pricing rules to first-time buyers only?

Yes. Under Customer Eligibility, select First-Time Buyers. PricePress automatically inspects the customer’s completed order history and only activates the discount if the customer has zero previous completed orders.

Can I require a coupon code before a dynamic pricing rule activates?

Yes. In the rule’s conditions, specify a coupon in the Require Coupon Code field. The dynamic pricing rule remains dormant until that specific coupon is applied in the cart or checkout. This is ideal for private VIP email blasts, influencer marketing, and tracking promotional campaign ROI.

Can I set global and per-customer usage redemption limits?

Yes. You can set a Global Usage Limit to cap total storewide campaign redemptions (e.g., “First 100 orders only”), as well as a Per-User Limit (e.g., “1 redemption per customer account”).

Can I target products by Product Tags?

Yes. Under Promotion Target, choose Product Tags to target items associated with specific tags (e.g., clearance, summer-sale, flash-deal, overstocked).

Can I selectively export and import pricing rules and settings?

Yes. In PricePress → Settings → Export & Import, you can choose exactly what to export (Plugin Settings, specific Discount Rules with checkboxes, or both) and download a clean JSON backup file. On your destination site, upload the file to review its contents and selectively import settings and rules.

Can I display a Free Shipping progress bar in the cart?

Yes. When a rule includes a free shipping incentive or a cart subtotal threshold, PricePress renders a real-time, animated progress bar on the cart page (e.g., “Add $12.50 more to unlock Free Shipping!”).

Can I customize the on-page pricing table styling and hook placement?

Yes. In PricePress → Settings → Tiered Pricing Table, you can choose between Classic, Modern, Minimal, and Compact table designs, customize accent colors, and select from 5 WooCommerce hook positions (e.g., before or after the Add to Cart button).

Can I customize the On-Sale catalog badges?

Yes. In PricePress → Settings → Cart & Badges, you can customize the badge template (e.g. Save {discount} or 20% OFF), pick custom badge ribbon colors, and view a live visual product card preview.

Does PricePress support variable products?

Yes. PricePress fully supports WooCommerce variable products and individual product variations. You can apply rules to parent products, specific variations, or entire categories containing variable items.

Does PricePress slow down my store or checkout?

No. PricePress is engineered with micro-caching, optimized database schema indexing, and ultra-lightweight execution. Rule evaluation executes in microseconds, ensuring zero checkout friction or cart delay.
sections.changelog:
3.0.2

  • Fix: PHP warning “Undefined array key line_total” no longer appears when adding items to the cart (shipping cache clearing no longer builds shipping packages mid add-to-cart).
  • Fix: Mix & Match “any N for a fixed price” bundles now total exactly (e.g. any 3 for 50.00, not 50.01). Leftover pennies are distributed across the bundle’s lines, including multiple bundles in one cart.
  • Fix: Product, tag and category pickers in the rule editor now load the full catalog instead of stopping at the first 100 items, and saved selections are no longer dropped when editing a rule.
  • Fix: Tiered pricing tiers with the same min and max quantity (e.g. exactly 1) no longer apply to every quantity; the product page tier table matches the cart.
  • Fix: BOGO, Free Gift and Mix & Match discounts no longer double-apply or discount units outside complete bundles.
  • Fix: Campaign schedules (start/end date and active weekdays) are now enforced in the cart, not only on the storefront.
  • Fix: “Spend X” conditions are evaluated on the pre-discount subtotal, so rules no longer switch on and off between page loads.
  • Fix: Usage limits no longer count other campaigns (campaign 5 matched 15, 25, 50…), and orders without a PricePress promotion are no longer logged against an unrelated campaign.
  • Fix: Saving a rule on a fresh install failed because two columns were missing from the rules table. A migration adds them and re-activates rules left paused.
  • Fix: Product Stock condition now reads real stock; category/tag conditions handle the equals operator correctly.
  • Security: A paid cart line can no longer be converted into a free gift via the variation-switch request; free lines are verified against the rule that grants them.
  • Security: Per-customer limits no longer trust an email supplied in the URL; settings values are sanitized.
  • Improvement: Margin Protection (Pro) is now opt-in with a configurable minimum margin and a per-product “Cost of goods” field.
  • Improvement: Removed the unused free gift selection popup from the documentation; gifts are added automatically with an in-cart variation switcher.

3.0.1

  • Fix: Resolved PHP 8.2+ warning for undefined array key line_total during WooCommerce shipping package calculation.
  • Fix: Resolved PHP dynamic property deprecation warnings across rule evaluation contexts.
  • Fix: Synchronized free shipping rates and cache clearing across cart recalculations and checkout updates.
  • Fix: Improved checkout label consistency for promotional shipping rules.

3.0.0

  • Major Release: Complete architectural redesign with modular Condition and Action registries.
  • New: Dedicated Export & Import tab under Core Settings with selective rule checkboxes and plugin settings backup/restore.
  • New: Product Card Catalog Sale Badge live visual preview with custom ribbon colors and template formatting.
  • New: Real-world WooCommerce and PriceEngine integration for the Cart page (unmocked real progress bar, dynamic savings breakdown, and interactive free gift claim modal).
  • New: Shop Archive and Category loops dynamic price display (From $X) with strikethrough original prices for tiered pricing products.
  • New: Rule Exclusivity & Anti-Stacking priority engine — stops subsequent discounts from compounding unintentionally.
  • New: Campaign Usage Limits — Global storewide redemption caps and per-customer usage limits.
  • New: 4 Smart Conditions — Required Coupon Code dependency, Cart Total Item Count threshold, First-Time Buyer incentive (order count = 0), and Product Tags targeting.
  • New: 1-Click Rule Duplication (Clone) in the Discount Rules table.
  • New: Free Gift with Purchase and Mix & Match Bundle promotion engines.
  • New: AI Campaign Generator and visual rule simulation testing.
  • Enhanced: Redesigned modern admin dashboard with Chakra UI and Gutenberg components.
  • Enhanced: Clean header navbar with one-click Support & Bug Report button linking directly to DominoPress Support.
  • Optimization: Fully verified and benchmarked for WooCommerce HPOS and PHP 8.2+.

2.1.1

  • Fix: Resolved input validation issues preventing negative values.
  • Fix: Free Shipping threshold validation improvements.
  • Fix: WooCommerce cart caching fixes for promotional shipping rules.
  • Fix: Product Picker category and tag filter search improvements.
  • Fix: Pricing table placement on variable products below variation selects.

2.0.0

  • Major Release: Performance overhaul with optimistic UI state toggling and interactive placeholders.
  • Compatibility: Tested and certified for WordPress 6.9 and WooCommerce 9+.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with volume tiered pricing and promotional shipping thresholds.

  • Required Coupon Code: Gate dynamic pricing rules behind a specific WooCommerce coupon code for influencer partnerships and private email campaigns.

Intelligent Campaign Scheduling

  • Continuous / Ongoing: Run promotions indefinitely with no expiration date by default.
  • Date Range Calendars: Schedule start and expiration dates down to the exact minute.
  • Happy Hour Windows: Run recurring time-of-day flash sales (e.g., 2:00 PM – 5:00 PM on weekdays).
  • Day-of-Week Scheduling: Restrict promotions to specific days of the week (e.g., “Weekend Only Specials”).

🛡️ Margin Protection & Anti-Stacking Controls

Never lose money on overlapping promotions with built-in enterprise retail safeguards:

  • Individual Use Only (Anti-Stacking): Prevent multi-rule discount compounding. When a high-priority exclusive rule applies to a product, PricePress locks that product so subsequent rules cannot compound on top of it.
  • Usage Limit Per Campaign (Global Cap): Cap the total number of times a campaign can be redeemed across your entire store (e.g., 50% off for the first 100 orders only).
  • Usage Limit Per User (Account Cap): Limit how many times an individual customer account can redeem a promotion (e.g., 1 redemption per customer).

📦 Dedicated Export & Import Hub (Backup & Migrate)

  • Granular Selective Export: Choose whether to include plugin settings, discount rules, or both, with individual checkboxes to export only specific campaigns.
  • Interactive File Inspector for Import: Upload any PricePress backup JSON file to inspect rule names, types, priorities, and statuses before restoring.
  • Seamless Migration: Transfer promotional campaigns from staging environments directly to production in seconds.

🎛️ General Configuration & Calculation Controls

  • Discount Application Mode: Choose between applying only the First Matched Rule or Stacking All Matched Rules.
  • Calculation Base: Compute percentage discounts against Regular Price or current Sale Price.
  • Tax Handling: Calculate discount thresholds Before Tax or After Tax to comply with local tax regulations.
  • Coupon Suppression: Choose whether dynamic pricing rules can stack with standard coupons or suppress coupons entirely.
  • Flexible Table Placement: Hook volume pricing tables before/after add-to-cart form, button, or product meta.
  • Custom Cart Savings Message: Highlight customer savings on the cart page (e.g., “🎉 You saved {amount} on this order!”).

💡 Real-World E-Commerce Promotion Recipes

  • Fashion & Apparel: “Buy 2 T-Shirts, Get 1 at 50% Off” + Free Shipping on orders over $50.
  • Wholesale & B2B: Tiered volume discounts on bulk hardware (1–4 units @ $20 | 5–9 units @ $16 | 10+ units @ $12) for Wholesale accounts.
  • Health & Beauty: Complimentary travel sample automatically added to cart on all orders over $70.

  • VIP Retention: Exclusive 15% off storewide for VIP customers whose historic spend exceeds $300.
